# Fixtures

- `veto.tsv`, `never_prove.tsv` — copied from atomi
  `a4802e7cbe7ea6338e99dd21d3b84dbd6f871f76` (`tests/fixtures/`); MIT.
- `proofs/*.pvr` — generated by the pinned provari `v0.4.0`
  (`bceb1ee1faf7d9cf2422eb89c931be69ae30619d`) from the `veto.tsv` FENs and
  the two bench cells `core` and `easy-win`. They are not upstream files.
- `controls/core-truncated.pvr` — `proofs/core.pvr` with its last byte
  removed; a damaged zstd frame that both checkers reject.
